Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
import scipy.sparse
values = pd.Series(pd.arrays.SparseArray([0, 5, 0]))
print(values.sparse.from_coo(scipy.sparse.coo_matrix([[0, 2], [5, 0]])))
